name: xps
title: XPS Peak Fitting
description: Peak models of XPS spectra in the way CasaXPS builds them: a region, a Shirley, linear or Tougaard background, and synthetic components with CasaXPS's line shapes (GL, SGL, GL(m)T(k), LA(α,β)) and constraints between components (position A+1.5, area A*0.5, FWHM A), fitted by least squares with uncertainties, in a window where the components are dragged on the spectrum and written in a table (Analysis › XPS Peak Fitting…); and atomic concentrations from region areas and sensitivity factors. Binding energies in eV.

actions.name: xps_fit
actions.title: XPS Peak Fit
actions.description: Fits synthetic components over a background in one region of a spectrum, as CasaXPS's Components page does. Components are a list of dicts as the XPS Peak Fitting window gives them, or written one per line or per ';', lettered A, B, C...: 'name: shape pos=... fwhm=... area=... rsf=...', e.g. 'C-C: GL(30) pos=284.8; C-O: GL(30) pos=A+1.5 fwhm=A'. A value is a start (284.8), limits (284.8[284,286]), fixed (284.8!) or tied to another component (A+1.5, A*0.5, A). Makes the region's data, background, each component on the background, the envelope and the residual, and a graph of them on a reversed binding energy axis; reports positions, FWHMs, areas with uncertainties, and each component's share of area/RSF.

components.title: Components
components.description: A list of components, as the XPS Peak Fitting window gives them: [{"name": "C-C", "shape": "GL(30)", "position": 284.8, "fwhm": 1.1, "area": 3000, "constraints": {"position": "", "fwhm": "A", "area": "A*0.5"}}, ...]; a constraint is "" (free), "284, 286" (limits), "fixed", or "A", "A+1.5", "A*0.5" (tied to component A). Or a table as text, one per line or per ';': 'name: shape pos=... fwhm=... area=... rsf=... gauss=...', e.g. 'C-C: GL(30) pos=284.8; C-O: GL(30) pos=A+1.5 fwhm=A'.

energy.title: Energy
energy.description: The energy of each point; without it, the spectrum's X scaling.

region.title: Region (eV)
region.description: Binding energies from and to (after the shift); the whole spectrum when left out.

average.title: Average width
average.description: How many points at each end of the region are averaged for the background's end levels.

energy_axis.title: Energies are
energy_axis.description: kinetic: binding energy = photon energy − kinetic energy.

shift.title: Charge correction (eV)
shift.description: Added to every binding energy: −0.8 when C 1s is at 285.6 eV and should be at 284.8 eV.

actions.name: xps_preview
actions.title: XPS Peak Preview
actions.description: What the XPS Peak Fitting window draws while the components are edited: the region, its background, each component as its values and constraints give it, the envelope and the residual. It fits nothing and makes nothing; use xps_fit to fit.

actions.name: quantify
actions.title: XPS Quantification
actions.description: Atomic concentrations from the areas of regions over a background, divided by their relative sensitivity factors. Regions are written one per line or per ';': 'name: from to rsf=...', e.g. 'C 1s: 280 292 rsf=1; O 1s: 526 538 rsf=2.93'. Each is taken from the first spectrum that covers it, so a survey or narrow scans both work. Makes the backgrounds, with the spectra's own scaling.

spectra.title: Spectra
spectra.description: A survey, or narrow scans of the regions.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: One per line or per ';': 'name: from to rsf=...' in binding energy (eV), e.g. 'C 1s: 280 292 rsf=1; O 1s: 526 538 rsf=2.93'.

energies.title: Energies
energies.description: The energies of each spectrum, in the same order; without them, the spectra's X scaling.

ke_exponent.title: Kinetic energy exponent
ke_exponent.description: Areas are also divided by KE^x (transmission and escape depth); 0 when the RSFs already include them.

editors.name: xps
editors.title: XPS Peak Fitting
editors.description: Components of a region of an XPS spectrum, dragged on the spectrum and written in a table as on CasaXPS's Components page, fitted over a background.
